name: Build manager
author: Brett
description: Everything about builds in one place. Remaining: pending items not complete, build-queue steps not done and plan features nothing else covers, one row per build, with model, status, time left, steps and 'needs split'; Start build now (row button + context menu) plans it (dependencies first, queue reordered, never on top of a running build or its folders), asks axHub vps.run (Brett approves) to run headless Claude Code on the VPS on its own branch, then checks nothing broke. Live: every build any session on any machine reported to axHub (VPS, other computers, claude.ai, console launches, subagents), in real time, with elapsed vs estimate, cost, model, where it runs and a 'no word' flag when a session goes quiet, plus the activity feed. Built: every finished build with time and cost (actual or estimated), totals by model and week, filters. One search bar across all three. Banner while something builds.
